stem: Formative: What makes nominal emitter flow insufficient for troubleshooting installed irrigation?
choices: Clogging, pressure, filtration, line position and wear can change actual delivery.
Nominal ratings are always intentionally false.
Installed systems do not need field checks.
rationale: Clogging, pressure, filtration, line position and wear can change actual delivery. This preserves the evidence and role boundary required by the referenced verification framework.
